composition_subtypes.role: Build initial maximum matching of power-of-two counts
Feasibility check by matching remaining counts with higher powers

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy preprocessing builds canonical form; two-pointer greedy matching checks feasibility to enumerate valid original lengths.
payload.rationale: First greedily constructs initial counts using sorted input; then employs a two-pointer greedy algorithm to verify if a configuration can be extended, combining them to iterate over all possible lengths.
